description: Miracle Claw bridge capability — grants chat UI at 127.0.0.1:28789 access to invoke THREE custom Tauri commands: openclaw_back_to_dashboard, mc_open_overlay (Lesson 244), and mc_close_overlay (Lesson 247). The permission manifest is declared in src-tauri/permissions/ (Lesson 513 rc19). Activated only on the http://127.0.0.1:28789 origin via the `remote` URL pattern. Deliberately scoped to `core:default` + these commands — NO shell:allow-execute or filesystem permissions. The main.json capability (local-only) retains those dangerous permissions and remains the only path to invoke them from the dashboard (tauri://localhost/index.html).
